# `tag_DH_ls.rds` staleness issue (2026-09-29) - RESOLVED 2026-11-05

**Status:** resolved. `data/clean/tag_DH_ls.rds` is regenerated by
`data_cleaning/03_create_DH_from_tag_subsets.R` every time the pipeline runs
(`run_pipeline.R`, stage `data_cleaning`, after 01 and 02). On 2026-11-05 the file
(14:14:29) is newer than `tag_subsets_ls.rds` (14:14:27), so it can no longer lag behind the
current tag subsets as long as the data_cleaning stage is run in order.

## What the 2026-09-29 note said

`data/clean/tag_DH_ls.rds` (written 9/18) was older than `tag_subsets_ls.rds` (written 9/20). A
recompute of `SU_E_ACT_RI_summ` / `SU_E_ACT_PR_summ` from the current
`tags_SURVUSE_OR_EUTH_&_ACTIVE` subset gave 129 spp/rel_loc/repID/status groups, one more than the
128 stored (45 RI + 83 PR), the extra group being an all-`NA` bucket of 115 detected tags. The
analysis in `eval_survival_data_to_inform_taglife.R` was therefore reading detection-history tables
built from an older population.

## Current state (checked 2026-11-05)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `tag_DH_ls[["SU_E_ACT_RI_summ"]]` + `[["SU_E_ACT_PR_summ"]]` | 45 + 83 = 128 groups, no `NA` bucket |
| File times | `tag_DH_ls.rds` written after `tag_subsets_ls.rds` |

The tables read by the taglife analysis therefore come from the same run as the current subsets.

## Corrections to the old note

- `R/get_DH_tag_code_summ.R` is **not** in `old/obsolete_funs/`; it lives in `R/` and is in active use
  (sourced by `data_cleaning/03_create_DH_from_tag_subsets.R` and the tagger_effects scripts). The old
  "source from `old/obsolete_funs`" step was never needed. Its unused exploratory pivots (one of which
  produced a list-column warning) were removed on 2026-11-04 without changing the output.
- The 129-vs-128 difference in the old recompute is not fully explained. The likeliest cause is that
  the ad-hoc recompute used all events rather than only the events of the subset's tags. The scripts
  now agree with the stored 128 groups; if the `NA` bucket reappears, compare
  `get_DH_tag_code_summ()` inputs with `filter_events_nodes()` in `data_cleaning/03`.
